function: Multi-UAV hybrid-action DRL allocating transmit power, bandwidth, number of semantic symbols and UAV trajectory over air-to-air relay and air-to-ground links to maximize QoE minus transmission cost (p. 9-10).
system: Two UAVs at 100 m with air-to-air relay and air-to-ground links, 5 users per region, 2.5 MHz, 6 W; antennas, band not stated; no RIS (p. 7, p. 12).
method: Multi-agent actor-critic DRL: DDPG actor for trajectory, hybrid actor with DQN-style critic for discrete semantic-symbol number plus continuous power and bandwidth; pre-trained ViT semantic transceivers (p. 10-12).
data_channel: Simulated channels: free-space air-to-air loss, probabilistic LoS/NLoS air-to-ground loss with Rician or Rayleigh fading; Karpathy-splits image-caption data trains the semantic transceivers (p. 7-8, p. 12).
test_conditions: Agents trained 500 episodes of 200 steps; QoE swept over bandwidth, power, user number, user groups and region distance; no train-test mismatch stated (p. 12-15).
baselines: Non-learned: EA-MSC equal power and bandwidth allocation at fixed position (symbols by DQN); learned: MADDPG-ISCFS, MADDPG-TC with JPEG/BPG and LDPC, MHDCD-ISC (reflects [27]), MHDCD-MSCFP (p. 12).
metrics: Average QoE, transmission cost, reward convergence, and SSIM and BLEU accuracy versus SNR (p. 12-15).
complexity: none; only a qualitative remark of larger action space and higher computational complexity (p. 13).
q1_support: p. 7: "The A2A path loss between UAV Uk and UAV Um follows the free space path loss model [44]"; air-to-ground uses a probabilistic LoS/NLoS loss with Rician or Rayleigh fading (p. 7-8). Custom simulator; no 3GPP TR 38.811/38.901, DeepMIMO or measured channel data; missing.
q2_support: p. 12: "The scheme is trained over 500 episodes, with each episode containing 200 time steps"; Figs. 7-12 (p. 13-15) sweep bandwidth, power, users and region distance, but no passage says a trained agent is tested on a condition unseen in training; missing.
q3_support: p. 12: "Both bandwidth and transmit power are equally allocated to each user and UAV, and the number of the transmitted semantic symbols is optimized by the DQN scheme" (EA-MSC, simple non-learned allocation); p. 12: "multi-agent deep deterministic policy gradient (MADDPG) [49] to optimize communication resource allocation" (learned benchmark); QoE and cost comparisons in Figs. 6-10 (p. 13-14). EA-MSC still uses DQN for the symbol number.
q4_support: p. 13: "MHDCD-MSC has a larger action space and higher computational complexity" is qualitative only; no complexity order, operations, parameter count or runtime anywhere; layer sizes 400 and 300 neurons (p. 12) are architecture settings; missing.
q5_support: p. 12: "dataset [39], which includes 123287 images with 5 related text descriptions for each image, is employed for system training and testing" is learning-task data only; channels are simulated (p. 7); no link to code or data; missing.
notes: Area 6: the DRL controls transmit power, bandwidth and trajectory (plus semantic symbol number) of aerial links; passes above_phy because power and resource control in aerial links is physical layer, learned jointly with the trajectory (p. 9); NTN admits single-antenna links, and antennas are never stated. q3 borderline: EA-MSC (equal allocation at fixed position) is the only non-learned allocation baseline but keeps DQN for the symbol number (p. 12), and no optimization baseline is given (p. 9); the learned benchmarks are the MADDPG schemes; the reviewer may confirm. The semantic transceivers are pre-trained ViT models (p. 12), not the learned function graded here.
